name: seo-scale-keywords
label: SEO - Scale Proven Keywords
desc: The engine of a two-loop SEO system: earned per proven bet by a day-7 SCALE verdict, it compounds one keyword family — land-grab to harvest — one gated PR per run, until it proposes its own sunset.
description:
Set up an ENGINE loop — the scale half of a two-loop SEO system. An engine exists PER PROVEN BET and owns the middle of the keyword lifecycle: land-grab → flip gate → harvest → sunset proposal, compounding one keyword family with cluster articles and enrichment. Distilled from two live production fleets. Setup is a guided conversation — confirm each step with me before creating the loop; never create a blind loop.

## Step 1 — Earn the engine
- An engine must be EARNED, never speculatively spawned: the bet cleared its companion bet-manager loop ("SEO - Try New Keywords" — on a new site set that one up first), entered the bet ledger with a one-line thesis, and got a day-7 SCALE verdict on the daily series. No SCALE verdict → no engine; the bet stays with the bet manager. Verify the ledger entry exists before creating anything — this gate is what keeps engine count flat, because the fleet's bottleneck is the human merge gate.

## Step 2 — The regime and the ground truth
- Verify GSC access (query-dim + page-dim rows for the sc-domain property) with one hand-run query.
- Pick the regime — the single most consequential decision in the file. LAND-GRAB (the head term is emerging, the SERP thin): north star = exact-head position ≤3 plus family footprint; one new cluster article per run; a COMPUTABLE flip gate (family_top3_share ≥ 85%, family growth <10% vs the prior run, family_weak ≤ 2) decides the switch to HARVEST — emitted as metrics, never re-argued from a vibe. HARVEST (demand established): north star = 28-day clicks; one enrichment per run on the highest click-opportunity page.
- Name the breadwinner — the page earning ≥30% of clicks. Don't know it? You are not ready; run the bet manager for a week first.
- Write the fan-out carve-out BEFORE run 1 or the KPI will lie: query families that score zero BY DESIGN (LLM fan-out, competitor-navigational, brand-navigational, anonymized tail) are never deleted, retitled, or "fixed". Name sibling loops and their carve-outs — two loops editing one page destroys attribution.

## Step 3 — The run doctrine (hard rules)
- Score on the DAILY series (3-day median vs alert bands), never a trailing window. Merged is not live: verify the production URL serves 200 before counting anything shipped, and while this loop's PRs sit unmerged a flat position is EXPECTED — it suspends clocks, never triggers a strategy change.
- Canary + cooldowns: a breadwinner position drop ≥3 or clicks drop >30% flags FIRST and queues no edits against it today; 14-day breadwinner / 7-day page cooldowns, one edit per page per window. A verification ledger re-checks every applied change at +14 days and flags REVERT recommendations — the loop never reverts itself.
- Ship gates, ALL must hold: the cannibalization pre-check (never target a head term one of your own pages already ranks pos <15 for), the written CTA test, the fact-check gate (every new verifiable specific verified against a primary source THIS RUN), the queue gate, and the quality valve — nothing clearing the bar ships nothing. PR-only lane first; auto-apply is earned weeks later and stays tiny, additive, never the breadwinner.
- Every engine ends: sunset is a PROPOSAL, never a self-execution — flatline (21+ flat daily reads with zero unmerged PRs) or demand migration flags a close with the numbers; the human ticks it, the pages fold into enrichment scope, and the successor term goes back to the bet manager as a brand-new bet.

## Step 4 — Author the task file from the template + dashboard
- Fetch the full task-file TEMPLATE at <server-url>/api/skill/references/templates/seo-scale-keywords/reference.md (on demand — it is not in this prompt), copy it into the loop folder as the task file, fill every <FILL: …>, pick ONE regime branch and delete the other, and delete the SETUP block.
- Attach the marker-gate pre-run workflow: it counts remaining <FILL: markers and refuses to escalate to the agent while any remain. Repoint its TASK constant at YOUR task file by absolute path — a clone that skips this reads the template master forever (the known footgun; the gate message prints the path it read).
- Dashboard at creation: chart kpi_clicks_28d plus the regime metrics (family_top3_share, family_queries, family_weak), prs_unmerged, and status_drift_found. Cadence: daily (e.g. ~9am), staggered off sibling loops so GSC load and the repo working tree never collide.
